EME-2.before: To be great is to be misunderstood.
EME-2.after: To be great is not to be misunderstood.

LUC-2.before: Thus naught could evermore push forth and go, since naught elsewhere would yield a starting place.
LUC-2.after: Thus naught could evermore push forth and go, since naught elsewhere would not yield a starting place.

LUC-3.before: For were it not their wont thuswise to swerve, down would they fall, each one, like drops of rain, through the unbottomed void; and then collisions ne'er could be nor blows among the primal elements; and thus Nature would never have created aught.
LUC-3.after: For were it not their wont thuswise to swerve, down would not they fall, each one, like drops of rain, through the unbottomed void; and then collisions ne'er could be nor blows among the primal elements; and thus Nature would never have created aught.

THO-1.before: The government itself, which is only the mode which the people have chosen to execute their will, is equally liable to be abused and perverted before the people can act through it.
THO-1.after: The government itself, which is only the mode which the people have chosen to execute their will, is equally liable to be abused and perverted before the people cannot act through it.

THO-3.before: If the injustice is part of the necessary friction of the machine of government, let it go, let it go: perchance it will wear smooth, certainly the machine will wear out.
THO-3.after: If the injustice is not part of the necessary friction of the machine of government, let it go, let it go: perchance it will wear smooth, certainly the machine will wear out.

THO-4.before: If any think that their influence would be lost there, and their voices no longer afflict the ear of the State, that they would not be as an enemy within its walls, they do not know by how much truth is stronger than error, nor how much more eloquently and effectively he can combat injustice who has experienced a little in his own person.
THO-4.after: If any think that their influence would not be lost there, and their voices no longer afflict the ear of the State, that they would not be as an enemy within its walls, they do not know by how much truth is stronger than error, nor how much more eloquently and effectively he can combat injustice who has experienced a little in his own person.
